# coolify_server (Data Source)

Fetches a single Coolify server by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_server" "main" {
  uuid = "og888os"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `ip` (String) IP address or hostname.
- `is_reachable` (Boolean) Reachability on last check.
- `is_usable` (Boolean) Fully validated and usable.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `port` (Number) SSH port.
- `proxy_type` (String) Reverse proxy type.
- `user` (String) SSH user.
